name: Central Shopping Research, Affiliate & Content Placement Bridge

allFrontQueensCheck.rule: Every front request classifies shopping/procurement/content-placement need during Queens. NONE continues with zero commerce calls. OPTIONAL/REQUIRED routes only matched needs to the correct app domain.
allFrontQueensCheck.hourlyControl: Reuse an existing central physical wake/processTaskQueue. Perform a logical due check only; never create a separate blind shopping crawl timer.

domainIsolation.travelBooking: TICKET/PASS/RESERVATION use official Travel live/booking lane; do not mix venue/hotel/restaurant reviews into BRG_032 physical-goods review evidence.
domainIsolation.highStakes: Food safety/nutrition, structural/safety, legal, financial or doctrinal claims require official/canonical sources; shopping reviews are supporting experience signals only.
domainIsolation.internalApps: Queens/Seed/internal control apps do not invent shopping needs; they only normalize, qualify and route evidence.

contentIntegration.contentOs: ContentOS text/video packages call the shopping-need classifier after editorial intent is known. A shopping link/PPL slot is added only when it increases usefulness and the offer is verified.
contentIntegration.article: context/problem → evidence/content value → optional verified product/material/ingredient recommendation → alternatives → disclosure
contentIntegration.video: story/value first → natural PPL prop/usage moment → evidence-backed reason → short CTA → disclosure metadata
contentIntegration.vtube: persona snapshot and storyboard stay primary; PPL product/prop is a scene asset with placement reason, visibility window, dialogue optionality, fatigue cap and disclosure flag.
contentIntegration.publicPublish: Publisher Core receives draft package. Public post remains human-gated under existing policy.
